name: Lechtal-Camping Rudi
beschreibung:
History

The website lechtal-camping-rudi.at names as operator the family Volker Riedmann, address Luxnach 122, 6651 Häselgehr. A founding year of the site is not on the pages retrieved. The site describes itself as camping in the Tyrolean Lechtal, quietly located, as a starting point for hikes and high-mountain tours in the Lechtaler and Allgäuer Alpen. camping.info lists the same site under Luxnach 122, names an area of 0.8 hectares, 50 pitches, of which 38 are tourist pitches, an altitude of 1004 metres and the location on the river, a few hundred metres east of the village. The operating times on camping.info are 1 January to 31 December. The site’s own website sets a concrete closure against that and is thus the more precise source for 2026.

Getting there

The contact page names mobile +43 676 7394924 and info@lechtal-camping-rudi.at. camping.info describes the approach via the B 198 through the Lechtal to Häselgehr and then in the village northwards following the signs. The same page names the next village and the next bus or train station at about 0.7 kilometres each and the next town at 28 kilometres. Neither the site page nor this profile publishes a line number. Short-notice enquiries should be made by telephone. A reservation requires a deposit. Without a deposit there is no guarantee of availability. If the deposit is not paid within three days, the reservation becomes void. In the case of a later arrival or an earlier departure the total amount is also payable for days not used. Cancellation: up to four weeks before the start of the rental, refund of the deposit minus a 30 euro processing fee; two to four weeks beforehand, half of the deposit; from two weeks before the start of the rental, no refund.

Tips

From 5 October 2026 to 1 November 2026 the reception is staffed only from 8:00 to 10:00 and from 17:00 to 20:00 for arrival, registration and settlement; additional service does not apply. From 2 November 2026 to 13 December 2026 the site is closed. In summer the homepage names walks, hut hikes, mountain tours, cycling and mountain biking on a cycle path at the site, canoeing and rafting with a put-in and take-out for boats that belongs to the site. In winter the site advertises a cross-country trail network about 120 kilometres long, a trail directly at the site, ski lifts and natural toboggan runs. The FAQ names in Häselgehr, about 2 kilometres away, an MPreis shop and a filling station.

The summer price list 2026 applies from 14 May 2026 to 26 October 2026 and is shown including the Lechtal Aktiv Card. Person from birth year 2010: 14.50 euros. Child birth years 2011 to 2019: 8.50 euros. Small child birth years 2020 to 2023: 5.30 euros. Visitor’s tax from birth year 2010: 2.60 euros per night. Pitch 13.50 euros, electricity 1.20 euros per kilowatt hour, car 4 euros, tent depending on size 5 to 12 euros, motorcycle 2.50 euros, dog 4 euros and only on a lead, environmental charge 2 euros per unit. Propane-gas exchange at the site, wooden hut on request. The prices are those of the PDF from November 2025 and can change.
kurzbeschreibung: Campsite of the family Volker Riedmann at Luxnach 122, Häselgehr, on the Lech, with a summer and a winter season and a stated closure in November and December 2026.
